groups.name: status page v3 drops the impact line
groups.note: The feed carries impact on all 5 incidents in snap-01; the v3 page shows none. That breaks 0009's guardrail ('shows every field an incident carries'), and front desks read impact out to customers (m-02). 0009 says a broken guardrail is a bug, so no owner decision: add impact back to v3, or set status_page_v3 to 0 until it ships. The 1.9% contact rate (fn-036, fn-038) meets the target, but it isn't the guardrail.

groups.name: release gate for status page v3 tested nothing
groups.note: 0009 says 'Release gate: Passed on ci-2159'. ci-2159 (release/status-page-v3, 2026-10-15T13:06:17Z) shows 41/41 with 'diff: none', so the gate ran on an empty diff. The v3 layout ran only on branch runs ci-2149 (+188 -127, 40/40) and ci-2150 (+31 -18, 40/40), and nothing checked that the page shows every feed field, so the impact line was lost unseen. Make the gate run on the release diff, fail on an empty one, and add a check for every feed field.
